title: session.snapshot
description: One bounded snapshot with no subscription (plan 027 §3.4): of the main transcript, or of the child agentId names, with its own cut inside it and the same windowing and truncation marks as an attach. Bounded history is this, not a page API. A snapshot the budget cannot hold is failed, reason snapshot_too_large.

budget.description: The snapshot's byte budget: absent for the default (4 MiB), capped at 8 MiB.
